title: Harden default signaling worker: open-relay abuse bound + Origin/CORS check (task 1353 follow-up)
description:
HARDENED workers/signaling against open-relay abuse (task 1353 follow-up).

GUARDS + DEFAULTS (constants in src/relay.ts LIMITS):
- MAX_CONNECTIONS_GLOBAL=2000 (DO fetch -> HTTP 503), MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_IP=50 via cf-connecting-ip (-> HTTP 429); live sockets counted via getWebSockets()+attachment.ip.
- MAX_TOPICS_PER_CONNECTION=50, MAX_SUBSCRIBERS_PER_TOPIC=100 (over-cap subscribes silently ignored; cap also honored in the hibernation attachment topic list).
- MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES=64KiB (oversized frame dropped + socket closed WS 1009) via frameByteLength().
- Per-connection publish rate limit: TokenBucket 60 burst / 20 per s (excess publishes dropped). Bucket cleaned up on removeConnection.
- Origin allowlist: env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS wrangler var (comma/space list) -> isOriginAllowed()/parseAllowedOrigins(); empty/unset/'*' = open (shipped default); non-empty rejects disallowed browser Origin with HTTP 403; Origin-less non-browser clients allowed (soft, spoofable control). DO ctor now takes env.

All guards keep y-webrtc protocol semantics intact (subscribe/unsubscribe/publish-fanout/ping-pong).

TESTS: workers/signaling test/guards.test.ts (25 new) + test/relay.test.ts (23) = 48 pass, covering each guard cap-exceeded + normal-flow + Origin allowed/disallowed/missing/wildcard + token-bucket refill. 'wrangler deploy --dry-run' builds (13.74 KiB; ALLOWED_ORIGINS var bound). App: packages/** build green; @flash/authoring-ui 1150/1150 (incl. all collab); @flash/collab 28/28. 0 failures (better than the ~3 task-1207 fixtures budget).

DOCS: workers/signaling/README.md (abuse-hardening table + Origin config + corrected privacy scope: relay DOES see plaintext room-id topic + peer IPs, never k or doc bytes), docs/37-collab.md §8.4 (privacy scope + limits table + Origin config), wrangler.toml [vars] ALLOWED_ORIGINS doc, collabLink.ts comment corrected (room name IS the plaintext WS topic).
